Signers

Who is on duty, and what they are signing. Everything here is read from the pool — nothing on this page can start, stop or authorise anything. A signer appears only if it is set to announce itself; one that stays quiet still shows up under its signatures below.

—

On duty

Each row is one device. It signed its own announcement with a key it claims to hold, so the label and the keys are the device's own word, proven. Fresh means it spoke within the pool's freshness window; the age is always shown beside it, because "quiet" and "gone" are different facts.

In the pool

Transactions waiting for signatures, newest first, with the devices that have signed each one — matched by public key against the roster above. The pool keeps a transaction for about an hour from its start time, so this is a live window, not a record.
